_comment: TOOL #43 THE COLD LINE — the repertoire. 16 settings, sold as SEQUENCE.
Each entry is a STARTING POSITION, never a locked state: the marks and
the scale stay live in every one of them.
Named by what the SETTING SHOWS, which is the only thing a child
perceives. FREE = the first 5, and the three best moments are free:
the twin (the same span with no zero in sight), the same span again
entirely below zero, and the two marks in the same place.
The spine of the book is that SPAN IS INDEPENDENT OF POSITION. Entries
1-3 are all span 8 and look nothing alike. That is the whole tool, and
The domain is -30..30 and the window is 21 values, both DERIVED from a
measured legibility floor (see cold-line.js) — not the catalog's
refuted -40..40, which is 2.8px per unit on a 320px bench.
No entry names a unit, a weather condition, or an operation.
